authentication_notes: /auth/login and /auth/register are the only public entry points for authentication.
/auth/verify-email must be called after /auth/register before other authenticated endpoints work.
All non-auth endpoints except /categories, /offices, /reports/public, /reports/nearby, and /reports/{id} require authentication.
Admin operations (/users/municipality*, /roles) require elevated privileges implied by auth_required=true.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: POST /auth/login or POST /auth/register + POST /auth/verify-email is required before any authenticated endpoint.
POST /reports requires GET /categories to ensure valid categoryId.
PATCH /reports/{id} requires GET /categories for valid categoryId.
GET /users/municipality/user/{id}, POST /users/municipality/user/{id}, DELETE /users/municipality/user/{id} depend on the existence of a user created via POST /users/municipality.
GET /reports/user/{userId} depends on a valid municipality user existing (created via POST /users/municipality).
POST /users/municipality/user/{id}/office-roles and DELETE /users/municipality/user/{id}/office-roles/{officeId} depend on valid office and role resources.
GET /users/municipality/user/{id}/office-roles depends on valid office and role resources.
POST /auth/login -> GET /notifications: Session cookie from login is required to access user-specific notifications.
POST /auth/register -> POST /auth/verify-email: Registration creates unverified account; verification is required to activate full access.
GET /categories -> POST /reports: Report creation requires a valid categoryId from the categories list.
GET /categories -> PATCH /reports/{id}: Report update may change categoryId; must reference existing category.
POST /users/municipality -> GET /users/municipality/user/{id}: User retrieval requires a user to exist, created via POST.
POST /users/municipality -> GET /reports/user/{userId}: Report listing by user requires a valid municipality user ID.
GET /offices -> POST /users/municipality/user/{id}/office-roles: Office-role assignment requires a valid officeId.
GET /roles -> POST /users/municipality/user/{id}/office-roles: Office-role assignment requires a valid roleId.
GET /offices -> DELETE /users/municipality/user/{id}/office-roles/{officeId}: Role removal requires a valid officeId.
GET /offices -> GET /users/municipality/user/{id}/office-roles: Role listing may require office context for filtering or validation.

risks: POST /auth/register does not document email verification flow explicitly; client may assume immediate access.
/reports/{id} GET is public but PATCH is authenticated; potential race condition if public read allows unauthenticated updates (mitigated by auth check).
No documented rate limiting or brute-force protection for /auth/login and /auth/register.
POST /profiles/telegram/link does not specify token handling or expiration risks.
DELETE /users/municipality/user/{id} lacks soft-delete or audit trail documentation.
GET /reports/user/{userId} exposes user-specific data; ensure userId is validated against authenticated session context to prevent IDOR.
